description: Draft dose notes prepared from a user-supplied extract of BNF for Children 2023. Every note is marked unverified and must be checked against the complete current source before use. Version 5: adds 5 form lines from the second forms extract (valproate oral solution, doxycycline dispersible tablet, IV fosfomycin, morphine 1 mg/mL injection). Version 4 added available forms and strengths for 50 drugs (items 1–50 of the forms extract; valproate forms not loaded because the extract listed lithium products). Version 3 added items 81–120; 'CHECK' notes mark entries that appear to differ from BNFc or mix indications. Re-importing adds only regimens and forms you do not already have.
